scope: Candidate collection/identity audit, not factual screening or eligibility determination. All existing binary matches rehashed; all textcandidate paths freshly extracted fromPDFs to check stale-sidecar risk. No fullreading credit.

required_or_recommended_actions.issue: Root patched both scripts to include local_pdf and archivePDFfield where SHAavailable, then reran. Existing and added candidate matches independently reverified. This expands discovered candidates without establishing an exhaustive universe.

Text equality after whitespace removal can hide images, scanned/redacted covers, tables or signatures, and whitespace boundaries; retain candidate-only status. Lowtext flags are useful but do not prove all remainingvisualcontent identical.

Registrant is not necessarily actual author: misattached third-party documents already observed. Actual authored identity, exactversion and relevantdeliveryevent require adjudication even for byte-identical files.

Fingerprinted/downloaded documents may be drafts, government advice, primary evidence, historicalforwardedmaterial or duplicateevents. None becomes an eligible externalwrittenresponse or factualscreen solely by matching.
